west dead end against the lots of the Townsend-Elmore block

notes: North is up (sheet slightly rotated). Bare printed names kept bare: HOFFNER, CHERRY, COOPER, DORMAN, POWERS, TOESER, TOWNSEND, CICEL, BURGOYNE, DHONAU, ELMORE; COLERAIN AV. printed with AV. All points from fitted block lines (pipes checked: Colerain and Powers pipes are centred). Colerain runs straight NNW-SSE across the sheet (measured 60-61 ft, 63 ft at Elmore), crossing the C.H.&D. tracks between Cooper's two corners. Hoffner: 25 ft west of Colerain (both lines drawn, y 205/370) but printed 60' twice east of Colerain (vertical labels at x~2930 and x~5700), where only its south line is on the paper (y~412-447); the east-leg centre is taken 30 ft north of that line (agrees with the pipe to ~15 px). Hoffner therefore jogs ~11 ft at Colerain and is recorded as two T's on the Colerain centreline: west leg (2678,303) and east leg (2643,237) (same construction on sheet 614). Cherry's north side of Hoffner is off the paper; the key map shows a street continuing north, so Hoffner/Cherry is a cross. Cherry runs from Hoffner through Cooper and Dorman and stops at Burgoyne (T, as on sheet 612). Cooper leaves the east side of Colerain where the tracks cross it (no street on the west side), so T. Powers comes in from the west (40 ft, onto 614), bends at (3762,4214) and meets Colerain 85 px north of where Dorman leaves its east side: recorded as two T's (Powers/Colerain and Dorman/Colerain). Toeser (printed 30') leaves the south side of Powers just west of the bend and runs SSE to Cicel; Cicel (unprinted, ~21 ft, ~25 ft at its west end) runs from a dead end in the west to Toeser and stops there (L-corner, recorded as T). South of Cicel an unnamed ~20 ft way continues Toeser's line (its west side stepped ~10 ft east) to a dead end at the rear of the Elmore lots (listed under alleys, width not printed). The 20' alley (printed 20' at both ends) runs from Powers to Townsend between lots 1719/1714 and 1715/1713. Townsend crosses the railroad (its west part is the 614 overlap) and ends east of the alley. Burgoyne (30') and Dhonau (~31 ft, width not printed here) leave the east side of Colerain (T's); Burgoyne's north line is broken by Cherry. Elmore: only its north line is on the paper; centre taken 25 ft (150 px) south of it (matches the 10" pipe); it continues east of Colerain onto 612. The left part of the sheet overlaps sheet 614 (Powers and Townsend west of the tracks, the east end of 614's 10' alley at x~1780-2100, y~3340-3420); no intersections there. Circled numbers are grade elevations. Scale ~6.0 px/ft (scale bar).
